title: Hudson Tuf-Lite II 7000 Series | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Tuf Lite II 7000 series fan assemblies for induced draft cooling towers, built for efficient airflow and low vibration. Get specs at ICST.

layout.title: Hudson Tuf-Lite II 7000 Series | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 34′ through 36′ Diameter. Blade Counts from 6 to 14.

Hudson Tuf-Lite II 7000 Series (White, previously Blue) fan blades are made from fiberglass-reinforced vinyl-ester resin, which offers a high strength-to-weight ratio and ultraviolet and corrosion resistance. An elastomeric blade/holder joint cover prevents moisture from entering the blade.
